active_isolation_requirements.measurement: compare frontend sense voltage with and without isolation input attached
active_isolation_requirements.name: low_input_capacitance
active_isolation_requirements.requirement: the isolation input must not reduce the frontend sense voltage by more than 2x

active_isolation_requirements.measurement: two reset-pulse transient cases, one positive and one negative input difference
active_isolation_requirements.name: differential_preservation
active_isolation_requirements.requirement: both input polarities must keep the correct sign through the isolation output

active_isolation_requirements.measurement: same attached frontend, same Sky130 device models, same output-margin gate
active_isolation_requirements.name: usable_output_margin
active_isolation_requirements.requirement: the preamp output difference must reach at least 0.5 mV in both polarities

active_isolation_requirements.measurement: integrate or record supply current for the same run that measures margin
active_isolation_requirements.name: bounded_power_cost
active_isolation_requirements.requirement: the isolation stage must report its bias current before any system break-even claim changes

claim_boundary.allowed: turns the passive and source-follower failures into numeric acceptance requirements for the next active isolation candidate
claim_boundary.not_allowed: does not prove an active isolation circuit, latch decision, SAR conversion, DRC/LVS, post-layout converter energy, or accepted converter evidence
